description_1line: Graduate degree programs (PhD and master's) of the Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering; the school's own research-areas pages name 'Polymeric Materials & Soft Matter' as a research area with a named faculty roster.
notes: PACKET-LOCAL KEY NEW-UCHICAGO-PME — program_id allocated by the integrator at integration, never here. Wave 4 tranche 2 school pass 2026-11-12, owner department-row rule (SCHEMA §4.11 prong (b)): a department-level degree row only where the unit's own pages name polymers as a research area, track, or concentration of its degrees. Prong-(b) witness, PME's own research-areas page (institute-materials-and-sustainability/research-areas/polymeric-materials-soft-matter): 'Polymeric materials research at UChicago PME bridges soft matter chemistry and physics with macro-scale solutions to global challenges. PME researchers are developing functional and active polymers that process like traditional plastics while exhibiting advanced electronic, ionic, responsive, and responsive/adaptive properties, with impact across energy, water, sustainability, and human health.' The same page carries a Faculty roster for the area (Amanchukwu, Esser-Kahn, Gardel, Hsu, Nealey, Patel, Rowan, Tirrell, Wang, Xu). SEAM, stated plainly: this is the OSU-Chemistry-class seam (department pilot, PR #298) — the polymer naming sits on the school's own research-area page, not inside a degree-description page or catalog concentration list; it is stronger than UTK CBE's posture (polymers named only as themes inside other thrusts, held STILL_UNCERTAIN) because PME names the polymer area itself, as an area, with its own faculty roster. NOT a duplicate of PROG-000157: that row is the named MEng track credential (a track within one master's degree); this row is the unit's graduate degree program at department grain, the row the unit's PhD/master's faculty link to — the same two-grain pattern as Penn (PROG-000034 concentration + PROG-000343 CBE row). research_areas restricted to the polymer slice of the named area, from the area page's own text: polymer_physics ('bridges soft matter chemistry and physics') and recycling_circularity ('These efforts span circular-by-design plastics, the repurposing of existing plastic feedstocks into new functional materials'). polymer_physics is the row's softest cell (README weakest links). specialty_processes and specialty_materials held blank: the area page names no §3.1 process or §3.2 material family as the program's specialty. scale_band blank: PME publishes no program enrollment for these degrees, and S3 bars converting faculty counts or dollars. facilities_note blank: the area page names no facility (its 'next generation of AI-driven polymer labs are being designed and built' is prospective, not a facility statement). cip_code blank: no IPEDS completions pull ran in this lane. Credential set follows the school's published graduate degrees (PhD in Molecular Engineering; master's incl. the MEng, carried as ms per the PROG-000157 convention). Seven carried people records are proposed LINKs to this row in links.csv (Xu, Rowan, Esser-Kahn, Patel, Ferguson, Nealey, Wang) and two census mints (Amanchukwu, Gardel) — nine links ride on this row's creation; if the integrator declines the row, the fallback dispositions are stated in README §2.
